1.1.0.en: New: history log, Homey Timeline notifications, a manual reachability test per device, summary Flow triggers and condition cards for individual devices, and a more robust realtime connection. Plus various settings UI fixes.
1.1.0.de: Neu: Verlauf-Protokoll, Homey-Zeitleisten-Meldungen, manueller Erreichbarkeits-Test pro Gerät, Sammel-Flow-Trigger sowie Bedingungskarten für einzelne Geräte, und eine robustere Echtzeit-Verbindung. Dazu diverse Verbesserungen an der Einstellungs-Oberfläche.

1.2.0.en: New: "Ignore unavailable" per-device setting to keep a flaky device out of the summary trigger, timeline, and log (its own per-device Flow trigger still works). Unavailable log entries now show the device's last-seen time. Cleaner app icon.

1.4.0.en: New unavailable-delay grace period, applied to restarts too.

1.5.0.en: New "Zone + Name (A-Z)" device sort option. Improved dark mode text contrast, plus an optional setting to increase it further.

1.6.0.en: new setting to include the homey own last seen

1.6.1.en: homey's last seen against not reporting now as individual setting

1.7.0.en: per-device override for the "last seen" setting, a button to apply settings to all devices of the same type at once, and a "reset to factory settings" button. Cleaner settings layout, reduced background storage writes.

1.7.2.en: condition card also respects the custom values for delay. Addes checkbox when applying settings to same-type devices, so individual devices can be excluded

1.8.3.en: "Settings: "unavailable" status now aligned with the widget."

1.8.4.en: Shows the battery type (e.g. AA, CR2032) next to low-battery devices, in both the widget and device details, where the device's app declares it

1.8.5.en: Clarified that 'count last seen' only helps a minority of devices - hint text updated to set expectations correctly

1.8.6.en: Widget dark mode fix. Adds 'test device reachability' flow action plus 'test succeeded/failed' triggers and extends the test button to shutters, thermostats and speakers

1.9.0.en: New seasonal 'pause until date' option per device, plus a dedicated filter/stat for paused devices

1.9.1.en: Adds Flow cards for pausing - a condition 'device is paused' and two action 'pause device until' and 'resume device'

1.9.2.en: Fixed pause-date Flow cards not applying (date format mismatch) - two cards, native date picker and a text/token variant for dynamic dates

1.9.4.en: Fixed blank driver pairing icon on mobile (invalid icon.svg with embedded raster image)

1.9.5.en: New "any device" condition cards (unavailable / not reporting / low battery) - no device picker needed, for flows off the summary triggers

1.9.6.en: Fixed the Test button showing no success feedback for devices that aren't monitored

1.9.7.en: Settings: fixed the device search showing "no devices found" when only unmonitored devices matched. Matching zones and the unmonitored section now expand automatically while searching.

1.9.8.en: New setting: wait a few minutes after app start before the first automatic scan, to avoid a burst of false "not reporting" flags while device data is still settling

1.9.9.en: The log now also records recoveries (device available/reporting/battery ok again), not just problems

1.9.10.en: The log tab now refreshes every time you open it, instead of only on page load

1.9.11.en: More reliable recovery detection - a device missing from a single scan (transient hiccup) no longer silently loses its problem history instead of being logged as recovered

1.9.12.en: Fixed the device search placeholder text being nearly invisible in dark mode
1.9.12.de: Der Platzhaltertext im Gerätesuchfeld war im Dark Mode kaum lesbar - behoben

1.9.13.en: Added a color scheme setting (Auto/Light/Dark) under Display, plus a donate button at the bottom of Settings
1.9.13.de: Neue Farbschema-Einstellung (Automatisch/Hell/Dunkel) unter Darstellung, sowie ein Spenden-Button unten in den Einstellungen

1.9.14.en: Fixed excluded devices getting a "reachable again" log entry despite being excluded from unavailable tracking
1.9.14.de: Ausgeschlossene Geräte erhielten trotz Ausschluss von der Erreichbarkeitsüberwachung einen "wieder erreichbar"-Log-Eintrag - behoben
